notes.title: Aleph One 1.10.1
notes.content:
Classic Marathon Infinity has been updated to use Aleph One 1.10.1. This is a bug fix release. Highlights:
[list]
[*]Uses HUD filtering preference for Lua HUD images
[*]Physics file is no longer mandatory for gathering using dedicated servers
[*]It is now possible to mix workshop scenarios and local scenarios in the Steam version of Classic Marathon Infinity
[*]Fixes an issue interpolating ephemera
[/list]

notes.title: Classic Marathon Infinity Hotfix
notes.content:
We have posted an update to fix an issue where BoB could invalidate the the Chapel Groan achievement. Traitorous Pig! 

If you had trouble getting the achievement before, resume from a game saved in a prior level and try again.
